# Systems Implementation Agreement

This Agreement is made between Northwind Ledger Systems Ltd (the "Supplier") and Harbourline Freight plc (the "Customer").

## 4. Delivery
4.1 The Supplier shall provide a detailed implementation plan within 10 Business Days of the Effective Date.

## 7. Payment
7.1 The Customer shall pay each invoice within 30 days of the date of invoice.

# Software Licence Agreement

This Agreement is made between Pemberton Logic Ltd (the "Licensor") and Cardew Accountants LLP (the "Licensee").

## 12. Term and Termination
12.1 This Agreement continues for an Initial Term of 3 years from the Effective Date.
12.2 The Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 90 days' written notice.
12.3 The Licensor may terminate this Agreement immediately if the Licensee fails to pay any undisputed sum within 60 days of its due date.
12.4 The Licensee may terminate this Agreement on the second anniversary of the Effective Date without paying any early termination fee.
